title: Constant finite and completed coefficient objects and canonical reduction
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, chosen uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $A_{E,n+1}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1}$ for $n\in\mathbf N$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $Y$ be a scheme with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Write $S_n=(A_{E,n+1})_Y$ and $R=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}=\varprojlim_n S_n$, with projection $\pi_n:R\to S_n$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. In the categories of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], define the finite constant coefficient object to be the regular module $S_n[0]$, and the integral constant coefficient object to be the regular module $R[0]$. Let $\operatorname{Res}_n$ be restriction along $\pi_n$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Define the coefficient projection $R\to\operatorname{Res}_n S_n$ to be the $R$-linear map sending a section $r$ to $\pi_n(r)$ (equivalently, the map sending $1$ to $1$). Define the canonical derived reduction map $R[0]\otimes_R^L S_n\to S_n[0]$, using derived reduction [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction], as the transpose of this coefficient projection in degree zero under the normalized derived extension/restriction adjunction [lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction], with the exact restriction functor's single-complex comparison.
